presentation.short_description: Run a memory-focused diagnostic to gather evidence about RAM faults.

illustration.alt_text: A diagnostic interface testing server memory.

entities.education_text: Diagnostic results change what the technician knows; they do not themselves repair memory.

presentation.short_description: Inspect PSU indicators and telemetry for evidence of a power-supply fault.

entities.education_text: Status indicators can quickly narrow a suspected redundant-power problem.

presentation.short_description: Lists block devices visible to Linux.

entities.purpose: Inspect block devices and their hierarchy.
entities.education_text: Useful when determining whether Linux recognizes expected storage devices.

presentation.short_description: Remove a confirmed failed memory module and install a compatible replacement.

steps_summary: Power or isolate equipment as procedure requires.
Install compatible replacement in the correct slot.
entities.education_text: A repair changes machine state and should be followed by verification.

presentation.short_description: Replace a failed server power-supply module according to platform procedure.

illustration.alt_text: Technician replacing a hot-swap server PSU.

entities.education_text: Redundant platforms may permit PSU replacement while the system remains operational.
